_about: Assumptions for the one-page quick estimator. Self-reported hours are treated as hours that MAY count. NWIOI admissions confirms what actually counts.

educationCredit._note: Share of the education hours a visitor reports that may count toward the path's education benchmark. The high end never reaches 1.0, because self-reported hours rarely cover every content area, the per-area minimums and caps, and the live (synchronous) requirements.

supervisionCredit._note: Share of the supervision hours a visitor reports that may count (it must be with an AASECT certified supervisor under contract, with the right individual/group mix).

_unsureNote: For 'I'm not sure', the low price assumes they may have done up to this share of the benchmark; the high price assumes none of it counts.
_lowerBoundNote: The admin price-range buffer widens the range, but the lower bound never drops below this share of the most optimistic calculated cost.
